DFMA Review · S5 · mock-up of a screen change (D-023, proposed) · 8 Nov 2026

Passed checks and selectable setups

You asked for two things. First, the features with no finding, with the checks each passed, why, and the math, collapsed by default. Second, each setup in the Machine plan selectable to show its features with a brief why. The pictures are screenshots of the built screen on the real test parts (LESSONS "ui").

Your call

Approve, Change (say what), or Rethink.

Every number in a passed check comes from the same rule code and limit as the findings (each rule's passes() next to its check()), so the math can't disagree with a finding.

What I chose, and the alternatives

  • The Passed list sits under the findings, in the Findings panel, not in the legend. D-012 already kept a "Rules passed" list for later; this is that list.
  • A feature with any finding is not in Passed. Its finding shows what failed. Showing its passed checks too is a small change if you want it.
  • Walls are in Passed too (9 on this part). A real part can list hundreds, so they come last.
  • States: no part, or an error: no Passed group and no plan. Turning: no plan until S6.

Facts on the screens and their sources

  • Limits in the math: hole depth 6.0× (config/thresholds.toml:5), corner radius 0.031 in and 4.0× (:25-26), pocket depth 3.0× (:30), thin wall 0.030 in (al6061 table), drill match 0.0005 in (config/tools.toml), access 0.5° (docs/specs/first-version.md:290).
  • The passed text and math: service/dfma/rules/hole_depth.py:47, hole_size.py:43, corner_radius.py:57, pocket_depth.py:38, undercut.py:34, thin_wall.py:38, access.py:40. Example values are held by tests/service/test_passed.py.
  • The setup why: web/src/findings.ts:195 (tool reasons) and :232-264, from each feature's open directions and sizes; the cover rule: docs/specs/first-version.md:298-300.
  • "16 features · 22 checks" and the setup why texts are held by tests/e2e/test_passed_and_setups.py.
